confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of northern Thailand tourist towns, not from checked live prices or listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are the most reliable. Accommodation is less certain and July is low season in Pai, so room rates may be lower than peak-season levels. Cocktail and wine are derived from the local beer relationship: cocktails at roughly twice the beer price, and wine at a higher multiple because imported wine carries a markup in Thailand.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on other tourist-oriented towns and Chiang Mai in northern Thailand, adjusted upward for Pai's tourist premium on food, drinks and guesthouse rooms.
